title: Design System: egghead Workshop landing page

motion.name: details-link-background
motion.purpose: Hover transition removed for reduced motion.

components.name: Workshop details link
components.css: .ds-workshop-details { display:inline-flex; gap:20px; padding:16px 28px; border-radius:8px; font-family:var(--font-sans); font-size:17px; font-weight:800; text-decoration:none; color:#10110f; background:#d8836b; transition:background 0.15s; } .ds-workshop-details:hover { background:#eaa28d; } .ds-workshop-details:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-ring); outline-offset:6px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-workshop-details { transition:none; } }
